company.shortDescription: Pine Park Health sends doctors and nurse practitioners into senior living communities to see patients at home
company.description: Pine Park Health sends doctors and nurse practitioners into senior living communities to see patients at home. Because home visits are expensive, we built software that uses AI to read charts, call patients, triage concerns, and schedule the right patients for appointments.

productsAndServices.description: Primary care delivered in patients’ homes within senior living communities by board-certified physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician associates.
productsAndServices.name: In-Home Primary Care

productsAndServices.description: Preventive services that help identify health risks and support long-term wellness, including screenings, vaccinations, health planning, nutrition, and exercise counseling.
productsAndServices.name: Preventive Care and Health Screening

productsAndServices.description: In-home evaluation and treatment for common urgent health concerns, including minor injuries, infections, falls, respiratory symptoms, and other non-emergency needs.
productsAndServices.name: Rapid Care

productsAndServices.description: Ongoing management of chronic and complex conditions with personalized care planning, specialist referrals, testing, and communication across the patient’s care team.
productsAndServices.name: Chronic Condition Care and Specialist Coordination

productsAndServices.description: Medication review and coordination to improve medication safety, simplify prescriptions, manage refills and side effects, and align treatment with patient goals.
productsAndServices.name: Medication Management

productsAndServices.description: Primary-care-based support for common mental and emotional health concerns, including anxiety, depression, grief, loneliness, insomnia, stress, and substance use.
productsAndServices.name: Mental Wellness Care

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $15,000,000, or 25.64% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,795,243 to $189,011,819, a 27.82x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 44 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
